latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Free Video Generator Bot — generate 1080p AI videos from text or images.

- Generate short videos from text prompts or uploaded images; easy cloud-based AI video synthesis (no editing timeline).
- Automatic setup: obtains anonymous token (100 free credits, 7-day expiry), manages session and cloud GPU pipeline.
- Simple prompt-based actions: type what you want, e.g., "generate a 30-second video from my prompt with background music."
- Supports uploads, credits check, export, and viewing project status; responds in real time.
- Handles error states (tokens, file limits, credits, export restrictions) with clear user messages.
- Exports videos in standard formats (MP4, MOV, etc.) for seamless social sharing.
